config.emi.tooltip.info.open_info: Opens the Item Info screen for the hovered stack: how to get it, what it is used for and its details.
config.emi.tooltip.info.tooltip_hint: Adds a line with the Item Info key to item tooltips.
config.emi.tooltip.info.example_stacks: How many example stacks the Item Info screen shows next to each recipe category (as many as fit).
config.emi.tooltip.info.show_no_source:
Shows "No known source" for items that no recipe, loot table or other source in EMI produces.
Useful for pack developers.
config.emi.tooltip.info.show_advancement: Lists the advancements whose icon is the item in the Item Info screen, with their progress. Hidden advancements only show once you completed them.
emi_info.export.errors: %s entries could not be exported, see the log.
emi_info.export.aborted: Export aborted: EMI reloaded or the world was left.
emi_info.export.error.module_off: The Item Info module is switched off.
emi_info.export.error.not_loaded: EMI has not finished loading, or no world is open.
emi_info.export.error.running: An export is already running. Use /emiexport cancel to stop it.
emi_info.export.error.unknown: Unknown export "%s". Use recipes, items, sources, nosource, tags or all.
screen.emi_info.title: Item Info: %s
emi_info.empty: EMI knows nothing about this stack.
emi_info.no_source: Nothing EMI knows of (recipes, loot, world generation, trades...) produces this. It may only be available in creative mode, through commands or from a source no mod tells EMI about.
emi_info.tooltip.not_a_source: Only turns this item into itself (not a source)
config.emi.tooltip.info.extra_sources:
Adds the Other Sources category: sources that mods hand out in code, declared by emi_sources files in resource packs (see docs/SOURCES.md).
Needs an EMI reload.
emi_sources.minecraft.turtle_scute: Dropped once when a baby turtle grows up (needs the game rule doMobLoot).
emi_sources.minecraft.armadillo_scute: Shed by armadillos from time to time; brushing an armadillo gives one as well.
emi_sources.minecraft.dragon_breath: Fill a glass bottle from the lingering cloud of the Ender Dragon's breath.
emi_sources.minecraft.dragon_egg: Appears on top of the exit portal when the Ender Dragon dies for the first time in a world.
